verdict.rationale: FireHydrant Signals documents on-call schedules for teams. Schedules are described as a collection of rotations that can be targeted by escalation policies, which covers the core rotation-based scheduling in the story. The evidence does not mention time-zone handling, explicit layers or overrides, or round-robin coverage, and nothing independent confirms schedules fit real team patterns. Missing for 10: time-zone support, layered schedules or overrides, round-robin coverage, hands-on or independent corroboration.
